title: What Zero-G Art Studios Is
definition: Zero-G Art Studios: studios creating art in weightlessness.
description:
Zero-G Art Studios: studios creating art in weightlessness. This is Future Art, Design & Fashion at its most ambitious — parabolic labs research, studio logistics engineering and fluid dynamics operations converging on a single goal: making studio hulls real.

Why it matters: Future Art, Design & Fashion will decide exhibition outcomes this century. Zero-G Art Studios is one of the load-bearing ideas: without working studio hulls, the larger parabolic labs vision stalls, and with it, the studio logistics systems that depend on it.

This database documents Zero-G Art Studios in full: what it is, the real research behind it today, the pieces it is built from, dated forecasts, runnable demo programs, and a teaching ladder from foundations to mastery. Every record carries a working program you can run.

title: Readiness Estimator: Zero-G Art Studios
definition: Estimates Zero-G Art Studios readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Zero-G Art Studios components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a studio hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Zero-G Art Studios Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Zero-G Art Studios operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Zero-G Art Studios installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 461 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where parabolic labs monitoring, studio logistics redundancy, or fluid dynamics maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Zero-G Art Studios Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Zero-G Art Studios: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Zero-G Art Studios — studios creating art in weightlessness.

Phase 1 — Prove (parabolic labs): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (studio logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (fluid dynamics): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (exhibition): studio hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and space-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
